reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents cryptocurrency passive income as an easy and safe way to earn returns through referral-based account registration, submission of government ID and proof of address, deposits, and new-user bonuses. It also connects the activity to products with stated return rates and converting earned tokens into Philippine pesos. The speaker discloses that the activity carries risks, but the available video evidence does not establish whether the quoted returns were paid, whether data was misused, or whether viewers experienced losses.

citations.quote: In this video, I'll teach you the easiest and safest passive income in crypto.
here is the time deposit or your interest rate for digital banks
When we subscribe... So let's put some money here since we're subscribing.
they have 10% additional bonus for the first 180 days to new users
if it drops it will never lend your money if the 5 percent APR is exceeded if it's go down he won't be able to lend you the amount If basically you won't earn

opening.argument: Judge, the word “safest” should be read in the context of the speaker’s comparisons, not as a promise that viewers cannot lose money. He says there are still risks, identifies platform failure, and warns that money placed in an on-chain project may be lost. He also distinguishes coins that can fluctuate and cause losses. Those warnings give viewers material reasons to question the proposed returns; the record does not show a guaranteed payout.

citations.quote: even if I said, the safest version yet. there are still a few risks.
The only risk that I see here is the platform or the digital bank is closed or bankrupt or explored.
If anything happens to where you put the money you may lose your money, or will be halved
some of these coins are not safe because they are not stable coins, they fluctuate, so you can lose money.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening emphasizes a deposit demonstration and a 10% bonus, but the speaker limits that bonus to new users and the first 180 days. He also explains that lending below a selected APR may produce no earnings. Registration and an illustrated subscription therefore do not, by themselves, establish a promise that the quoted rate will be paid.

citations.quote: they have 10% additional bonus for the first 180 days to new users.
if it's go down he won't be able to lend you the amount If basically you won't earn

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Risk warnings do not undo the central pitch. The speaker calls this the easiest and safest passive income in crypto, directs viewers toward a product offering interest, and walks through putting money into it. A return-generating deposit tutorial can promote the activity even while acknowledging that losses are possible.

citations.quote: In this video, I'll teach you the easiest and safest passive income in crypto.
here is the time deposit or your interest rate for digital banks
When we subscribe... So let's put some money here since we're subscribing.

opening.argument: Judge, the substance is an operational explanation of different earn products. The speaker defines flexible and fixed terms, explains that a selected lending APR may leave funds unloaned and earning nothing, and separates on-chain earn from activity on the exchange itself. He even declines to recommend advanced products he has not tried, telling viewers to read their terms. That degree of qualification supports reading the video as a tutorial about how the products work, not proof of a deceptive earnings scheme.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The other side correctly identifies registration, ID verification and a subscription example, but those appear within a walkthrough of account setup and product controls. The speaker explicitly says he is not teaching cash-in and cash-out here. The cited steps show what a viewer could do on the platform; they do not establish that the demonstrated return was actually paid or that anyone’s identity documents were misused.

citations.quote: Then when you register you also need to submit your Government ID your proof of address same process when you opened an account in banks
I will not be teaching you how to do cash in and out I will just show you how to earn passive income and cash out

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A tutorial can also be a solicitation. Here the lesson culminates in a suggested deposit, a new-user return bonus and advice to take advantage of its limited period. Explaining product controls does not change the practical direction given to viewers: put funds into an earn product for interest.

So all I want to suggest is take advantage of these first 180 days
So, you will notice here that we have APR and APY and those are the interest rates that you'll earn.

opening.argument: Judge, the promotional link is disclosed as a referral that supports the creator, and the speaker expressly offers a route to the site without using it. He describes a trading discount associated with referral links. That looks like an ordinary disclosed promotion, not evidence that viewers must pay the creator or recruit others to earn. The record shows account verification and product descriptions, but it does not show the creator receiving a viewer’s credentials or a completed transfer to the creator.

citations.quote: It is a referral link and a way of supporting me as a Creator
If not, you can use another method just by visiting okx.com it's up to you
You can also get a referral link with an additional 10% trading discount It's a lifetime discount
Then when you register you also need to submit your Government ID your proof of address

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the referral, identity check and bonus as one suspicious chain. Yet the speaker identifies the referral’s benefit to himself and permits direct access instead. The bonus is described as limited to new users and 180 days, not as an unconditional return for everyone. Those facts do not prove the external service is safe, but neither does the cited material establish credential theft or a guaranteed payout.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclosed referral does not make the underlying pitch an ordinary discount video. The speaker tells viewers to register, shows where to subscribe with funds, and recommends taking advantage of the introductory earning period. The concern is promotion of deposits for passive returns, not a claim that the creator personally receives credentials or that viewers must recruit a downline.
